description: This file defines a local notes service for a note-taking application, including functions to create, read, update, delete, and list notes, with data persistence via JSON stored in local storage.

methods.name: readAll()
methods.description: Reads all notes from storage, normalizes each note, and returns an array of notes.

methods.name: writeAll(notes)
methods.description: Persists an array of notes to storage after normalization.

methods.name: makeId()
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a note using crypto if available, or fallback to a combination of timestamp and randomness.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously returns all notes sorted by most recently updated.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a specific note by ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new note with given title and body, assigns ID and timestamps.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and/or body, updates timestamp.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a note by ID.
